pairs: And the Lord spoke to Moses,
Vade, ascende de loco isto tu,
et populus tuus quem eduxisti de terra Ægypti,
you and your people, whom you led away from the land of Egypt,
into the land that I swore to Abraham, Isaac,
To your offspring, I will give it.
And I will send an Angel to precede you,
so that I may cast out the Canaanite,
et intres in terram fluentem lacte et melle.
and so that you may enter into a land flowing with milk and honey.
For I will not go up with you,
since you are a stiff-necked people,
ne forte disperdam te in via.
lest perhaps I may destroy you on the way.”
And upon hearing this very bad news,
et nullus ex more indutus est cultu suo.
and no one put on his finery according to custom.
And the Lord said to Moses:
I should at once go up into your midst
Now immediately put aside your ornaments,
so that I may know what to do to you.”
Deposuerunt ergo filii Israël ornatum suum a monte Horeb.
Therefore, the sons of Israel put aside their ornaments before Mount Horeb.
Moses took the tabernacle and pitched it beyond the camp at a distance,
who had any kind of question,
went out to the Tabernacle of the Covenant,
And when Moses went out to the tabernacle,
et stabat unusquisque in ostio papilionis sui,
and each one stood at the door of his pavilion,
aspiciebantque tergum Moysi, donec ingrederetur tentorium.
and they beheld the back of Moses until he entered the tent.
And when he had gone into the Tabernacle of the Covenant,
cernentibus universis quod columna nubis staret ad ostium tabernaculi.
And all discerned that the pillar of cloud stood at the door of the Tabernacle.
et adorabant per fores tabernaculorum suorum.
and worshipped at the doors of their tents.
Loquebatur autem Dominus ad Moysen facie ad faciem, sicut solet loqui homo ad amicum suum.
But the Lord spoke to Moses face to face, just as a man is used to speaking to his friend.
And when he returned to the camp,
his minister Joshua, the son of Nun,
a young man, did not withdraw from the Tabernacle.
Then Moses said to the Lord:
“You instruct me to lead this people away,
et non indicas mihi quem missurus es mecum,
and you do not reveal to me whom you will send with me,
and you have found favor before me.’
Si ergo inveni gratiam in conspectu tuo,
If, therefore, I have found favor in your sight,
ut sciam te, et inveniam gratiam ante oculos tuos:
so that I may know you and may find grace before your eyes.
Look favorably on your people, this nation.”
and I will give you rest.”
“If you will not yourself precede us,
ne educas nos de loco isto.
then do not lead us away from this place.
In quo enim scire poterimus ego et populus tuus invenisse nos gratiam in conspectu tuo,
For how will we be able to know, I and your people, that we have found grace in your sight,
ut glorificemur ab omnibus populis qui habitant super terram?
so that we may be glorified out of all the people who live upon the earth?”
Then the Lord said to Moses:
For you have found grace before me,
and I have known you by name.”
“I will show you all that is good,
et vocabo in nomine Domini coram te:
and I will call out with the name of the Lord before you.
And I will take pity on whomever I will,
et clemens ero in quem mihi placuerit.
and I will be lenient to whomever it will please me.”
“You are not able to see my face.
non enim videbit me homo et vivet.
For man shall not see me and live.”
there is a place with me,
and you shall stand upon the rock.
And when my glory will cross over,
I will set you in a cleft of the rock,
and I will protect you with my right hand,
And I will take away my hand,
and you shall see my back.
faciem autem meam videre non poteris.
But my face you are not able to see.”
